name: Type 2 Diabetes
algorithm: Ensemble of SVM + Random Forest + XGBoost + ANN (soft voting)
population: Women aged 21+ of Pima Indian heritage; glucose is a 2-hour OGTT value
caveats: Trained on Pima Indian women aged 21+; glucose is a 2-hour/postprandial or random value. Fasting-only or HbA1c-only inputs are handled by the guideline layer instead.

metrics.validation: 5-fold stratified cross-validation x5 repeats (held-out folds only)
